description: Offers a site to a new Site Owner by email, who accepts and picks where it lives. Returns approve_url and recipient (what the site needs beyond Free, the same for any address); the sender's bill doesn't change. keep_editor (default true): the sender stays Site Developer. A workspace site goes to its Site Owner or someone in it.

email.description: The new Site Owner's email (required unless confirm_token)
